doc.brief: The QProgressDialog class provides feedback on the progress of a slow operation.
doc.index_brief: Feedback on the progress of a slow operation

QString labelText() const.brief: This property holds the label's text

bool autoClose() const.brief: This property holds whether the dialog gets hidden by [reset](xref:qt:QProgressDialog)()

bool autoReset() const.brief: This property holds whether the progress dialog calls [reset](xref:qt:QProgressDialog)() as soon as [value](xref:qt:QProgressDialog)() equals [maximum](xref:qt:QProgressDialog)().

bool wasCanceled() const.brief: This property holds whether the dialog was canceled

int maximum() const.brief: This property holds the highest value represented by the progress bar

int minimum() const.brief: This property holds the lowest value represented by the progress bar

int minimumDuration() const.brief: This property holds the time that must pass before the dialog appears

int value() const.brief: This property holds the current amount of progress made.

void canceled().brief: This signal is emitted when the cancel button is clicked.

void forceShow().brief: Shows the dialog if it is still hidden after the algorithm has been started and [minimumDuration](xref:qt:QProgressDialog) milliseconds have passed.

void open(QObject *receiver, const char.brief: Opens the dialog and connects its [canceled](xref:qt:QProgressDialog)() signal to the slot specified by *receiver* and *member*.

void setAutoClose(bool close).brief: This property holds whether the dialog gets hidden by [reset](xref:qt:QProgressDialog)()

void setAutoReset(bool reset).brief: This property holds whether the progress dialog calls [reset](xref:qt:QProgressDialog)() as soon as [value](xref:qt:QProgressDialog)() equals [maximum](xref:qt:QProgressDialog)().

void setBar(QProgressBar *bar).brief: Sets the progress bar widget to *bar*.

void setCancelButton(QPushButton *cancel.brief: Sets the cancel button to the push button, *cancelButton*.

void setCancelButtonText(const QString &.brief: Sets the cancel button's text to *cancelButtonText*.

void setLabelText(const QString &text).brief: This property holds the label's text

void setMaximum(int maximum).brief: This property holds the highest value represented by the progress bar

void setMinimum(int minimum).brief: This property holds the lowest value represented by the progress bar

void setMinimumDuration(int ms).brief: This property holds the time that must pass before the dialog appears

void setRange(int minimum, int maximum).brief: Sets the progress dialog's minimum and maximum values to *minimum* and *maximum*, respectively.

void setValue(int progress).brief: This property holds the current amount of progress made.

autoClose.brief: Whether the dialog gets hidden by reset()

autoReset.brief: Whether the progress dialog calls reset() as soon as value() equals maximum()

maximum.brief: The highest value represented by the progress bar

minimum.brief: The lowest value represented by the progress bar

minimumDuration.brief: The time that must pass before the dialog appears

value.brief: The current amount of progress made
